lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin region. The spacing is semi-regular, forming a non-linear grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical regions of elevated luminance intersect with the primary blobs in the mid-body section, forming a structured grid where the blobs serve as primary anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is present along the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side to a shadowed gradient on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a dense cluster of smaller, high-luminance spots that transition from a structured row at the leading edge to a more stochastic distribution toward the trailing edge.
